name: Bad Faith
source:
A Mother brings her son to a specialized "Weight Loss" Clinic in order to help him lose weight.  But for weeks, treatment had shown no progress...

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/bad-faith-the-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位母亲带儿子去一家专门的“减重”诊所，希望帮他减肥。然而，几周治疗下来，情况仍毫无进展……

[来源：[url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/bad-faith-the-game]Itch.io[/url]]
